facts.text: The step function is 1 when z >= 0 and 0 otherwise.
Sigmoid values are sigmoid(-2)=0.1192, sigmoid(0)=0.5, and sigmoid(2)=0.8808.
ReLU is max(0,z): relu(-2)=0 and relu(3)=3.
Step has zero slope almost everywhere, so gradient learning cannot use it.
Sigmoid is smooth but flattens at both ends.
ReLU is simple and passes positive values unchanged.
